build_sync_bucket: build a sync function that uploads or downloads files between a local directory and an hf://buckets/ path
test_FilterMatcher: test the FilterMatcher class to match file paths against include and exclude fnmatch patterns
refactor_compute_sync_plan: refactor _compute_sync_plan to compare local and remote files and generate a SyncPlan with upload, download, delete, or skip operations
review_execute_plan: review _execute_plan to apply a SyncPlan by batch uploading, downloading, or deleting files
summarize_save_load_plan: summarize _save_plan and _load_plan for serializing and deserializing sync plans as JSONL files
